baseline: current_tracker preserves tracker settings, but does not execute orchestrator automatic switching
freshness: Use explicit aligned gesture.predicted; missing metadata is unknown. Raw detections observed before postprocessing are fresh, not necessarily correct.
clock: Source timestamps drive MediaPipe, motion and OneEuro. Strictly increasing source frames; repeated model calls within a frame use monotonic millisecond increments. Real perf_counter measures cost.

metrics.fresh_primary_output_rate: Fraction of ALL source frames whose first returned hand explicitly has predicted=false. Not visible-hand recall.
metrics.no_fresh_primary_intervals: Elapsed source time without fresh primary output. Includes absence/occlusion; end-of-clip gaps are censored. Not labelled tracking failures.
metrics.accuracy_and_interaction: null until independent visibility/identity/operation labels and full application replay exist
metrics.timing: Cold-start development timing including observation overhead. Not warmed benchmark or real-time application FPS.

data_split: Historical recordings are development only. New session held out for acceptance.
pending: Full application replay with inert controllers
